defect_observations: handbook/annex/p15/normal-domains-of-attraction.tex:721-728: the body (thm:p15-nda-examples item 3) speaks of any symmetric law with P(|X|>x)=x^{-alpha}; the annex computes with "one concrete law". Since H_X and q_X depend only on the law of |X|, the computation applies to every such law, but the annex does not say so explicitly.

Durrett Theorem 3.4.14 (p.152) states no nondegeneracy hypothesis; the handbook adds it and justifies the addition in thm:p15-nda-examples item 4. Recorded for the fidelity reviewer, not a coverage gap.
